armAbduction.method: each free upper limb turned rigidly about the centre of its humeral head, about the antero-posterior (Z) axis, i.e. abducted in the coronal plane; scapula and clavicle stay; soft tissue by a per-vertex share of the rotation angle (attachment sites for parts on bone, a gap-adaptive scalar field for the rest)
armAbduction.plane: coronal (rotation about the runtime Z axis): the anatomical position is defined in the coronal plane, and the antero-posterior position of the limb, set by the shoulder correction, is left as it is; elevation in the scapular plane would also carry the hand forwards

scapula.statement: modelling choice: scapula and clavicle are kept fixed, with no coupled scapular upward rotation, for an abduction of a few degrees
scapula.source: none opened; the usual attribution for "little scapular motion in the first 30° of abduction" is Inman VT, Saunders JB, Abbott LC, J Bone Joint Surg 1944;26:1–30, cited here from memory only

reason.zh: 钉在皮肤包拟合时所用的角：自动判据按 0.5° 取整，输入稍有变化就会跳一档，骨架指纹随之改变，皮肤包就装不上。
reason.en: pinned at the angle the skin package was fitted at: the automatic criterion is stepped by 0.5° and jumps a step on a small change of the input, which changes the skeleton fingerprint so that the skin package no longer installs.

armAbduction.angleChosen: smallest multiple of 0.5° at which, on both sides, the deep parts turning with the limb are at least 12 mm from the deep parts that stay (from the band 25–30% of the humerus down to the fingertips) and from the muscles of the axillary folds (from the band 45–50% down: 2 bands below the band in which their insertions on the humerus end; proximal to that the folds meet the arm by anatomy); 1 mm is added to the requirement for the point sampling

criterion.rule: arm ≥ 12 mm from the deep parts that stay from 25% of the humerus down, and ≥ 12 mm from the fold muscles from 2 bands (5% of the humerus each) below the band in which their insertions end
criterion.whyNotFromAQuarter: a gap from 25% of the humerus cannot be had by abduction: latissimus dorsi, teres major and pectoralis major insert on the humerus down to 30% of its length and lie along the arm below that; the gap between them and the arm opens like a hinge at the distal end of the insertions, so the band just below it stays under 12 mm at any small angle (see gapCurve.foldsClearFrom: the level from which the folds are clear stops rising after the first degrees)
criterion.anatomy: with the arm at the side the axillary folds lie along the arm and the medial arm skin touches the skin of the chest wall in a living person too; an axilla open from about mid-humerus is the anatomical resting state, and the chest wall itself was never the obstacle (see the wall columns)

reason.zh: 小腿筋膜是小腿的深筋膜，向上续于阔筋膜，向下续于踝部的支持带（小腿横韧带和分裂韧带），不延伸到足趾；图谱网格却一直包到趾尖，横在趾蹼之间。在趾根（跖趾关节平面）剪掉，余下的收到皮下。
reason.en: The crural fascia is the deep fascia of the leg, continuous above with the fascia lata and below with the retinacula at the ankle (transverse crural and laciniate ligaments); it does not extend onto the toes, whereas the atlas mesh wraps the foot to the toe tips and lies across the web spaces. Clipped at the toe bases (metatarsophalangeal level); the rest is taken under the skin.

source.name: Gray's Anatomy, 20th ed. (1918), p. 480, as quoted in Wikipedia “Deep fascia of leg”

reason.zh: 趾（指）的静脉起于趾（指）跖（掌）面的静脉丛，在趾蹼处发出头间静脉与背侧的趾静脉相连，再汇成跖静脉；趾背静脉在趾蹼处汇成趾背总静脉。它们沿各自的趾（指）走，所以应在自己的趾（指）之内。
reason.en: The digital veins arise from plexuses on the plantar (palmar) surfaces of the digits, send intercapitular veins to the dorsal digital veins at the clefts and unite to form the metatarsal veins; the dorsal digital veins join at the clefts into common digital veins. They run along their own digit, so each must lie inside it.

source.name: Gray's Anatomy, 20th ed. (1918), p. 671, as quoted in Wikipedia “Plantar digital veins” and “Dorsal digital veins of the foot”

reason.zh: 桡神经浅支的指背神经分布到拇指两侧、示指桡侧、示指与中指以及中指与环指的相邻侧的皮肤，尺神经手背支分布到其余的手指：都沿手指侧面的皮下走，所以应在自己的手指（足趾）之内。
reason.en: The dorsal digital nerves of the superficial branch of the radial nerve supply the skin of both sides of the thumb, the radial side of the index and the adjoining sides of index–middle and middle–ring fingers, and the dorsal branch of the ulnar nerve supplies the remaining fingers: all run under the skin along the sides of the digits, so each must lie inside its own finger (or toe).

source.name: Gray's Anatomy, 20th ed. (1918), p. 944, as quoted in Wikipedia “Superficial branch of radial nerve”

reason.zh: 深筋膜（包被筋膜）、腱膜和髂胫束都在皮肤和皮下组织的深面；略微露出皮肤（多在 2–3 mm 以内）是图谱配准的误差。用平滑的位移场收到皮下。只凭定义，没有另外打开出处。
reason.en: Deep (investing) fasciae, aponeuroses and the iliotibial tract lie deep to the skin and the subcutaneous tissue; standing slightly proud of the skin (mostly within 2–3 mm) is an error of the atlas registration. Taken under the skin by a smooth field. By definition only; no further source was opened.

reason.zh: 这里管到的其余薄结构（皮神经、浅静脉和浅动脉、指趾的关节囊和韧带、精索内的血管）都在皮肤的深面；露出皮肤是配准误差，或皮肤拟合时没有顾及它们。用平滑的位移场收到皮下。只凭定义，没有另外打开出处。
reason.en: Every other thin structure handled here (cutaneous nerves, superficial veins and arteries, capsules and ligaments of the digits, the vessels of the spermatic cord) lies deep to the skin; lying outside it is a registration error, or the skin fit not having considered them. Taken under the skin by a smooth field. By definition only; no further source was opened.

what.zh: 男性外生殖器的皮肤。patchVertices：阴茎、阴囊、阴囊颈和会阴缝，取自他本人的扫描皮肤（BodyParts3D 4.0 的 FJ2810 外壁），位置一个也没有动（标签 graftScanned）。blendRingVertices：把扫描片沿一条光滑的线切出来、以及切之前把扫描的长边对半分时，落在扫描三角形的边上的点（标签 graftBlend）；它们在扫描面上，但不是扫描的顶点。constructionVertices：扫描片边缘与拟合皮肤之间的过渡面（耻区、腹股沟、会阴和两大腿内侧上部），是构造物，不是扫描数据，也不是解剖（标签 graftConstruction）：以扫描在这一带的粗网格面为底稿，重新布网后光顺而成，与扫描片和周围的拟合皮肤相切。
what.en: The skin of the male external genitalia. patchVertices: penis, scrotum, scrotal neck and perineal raphe from his own scanned skin (outer wall of FJ2810 of BodyParts3D 4.0), not one position changed (tag graftScanned). blendRingVertices: points put on edges of scan triangles when the patch was cut out along a smooth line and when long scan edges were halved before that (tag graftBlend); they lie on the scanned surface but are not vertices of the scan. constructionVertices: the blend surface between the rim of the patch and the fitted skin (pubic region, groins, perineum and the upper inner thighs); it is construction, neither scanned data nor anatomy (tag graftConstruction): the coarse scan surface of that zone served as a draft, which was re-meshed and faired, tangent to the patch and to the fitted skin round it.

what.zh: 分开的脚趾、趾蹼和趾甲：供体是 CC0 的基础网格（不是这个人的脚，也没有骨骼）。每个趾按本体的趾骨链定位：供体趾尖对到远节趾骨末端加 3 mm 软组织垫，供体趾蹼对到近节趾骨上的蹼位；截面按趾缩放，并在骨上覆盖不足处局部外推。趾蹼之后的面贴在包里原来的皮肤上。全部顶点都被这样变形过（标签 graftCurated）；靠边一圈为过渡环（graftBlend，构造物）。
what.en: Separate toes, web spaces and nails: the donor is a CC0 base mesh (not this person's foot, and without a skeleton). Each toe is placed by this body's chain of toe bones: the donor tip on the end of the distal phalanx plus a 3 mm soft-tissue pad, the donor web on the web station of the proximal phalanx; the cross-section is scaled per toe and pushed out locally where bone cover would be short. Behind the webs the surface lies on the package skin. Every vertex was deformed in this way (tag graftCurated); the band at the rim is the blend ring (graftBlend, construction).
